protocol: wave-1 census: >=20 repos, registry JSON + tier rubric + >=4 GAP-SPH-* anchor proposals; wave-2 deep-dive relays the LBM protocol (machine-verified upstream path:line pointers)

provenance.note: numeric fields copied verbatim from raw probe; census repos without raw evidence are dropped, not hand-filled

tier_rubric.1: core-sph-solver: dedicated SPH solvers (WCSPH/PCISPH/ISPH), production or research grade
tier_rubric.2: sph-capable-framework: frameworks/ports with SPH as a module or language port
tier_rubric.3: ecosystem-infrastructure: host frameworks / HPC / visualization / ML infrastructure SPH builds on

gap_proposals.title: PCISPH 预测-校正不可压 SPH（现投影法路径的对照/替代）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 2D 溃坝（Kleefsman 几何）：自由面位置误差 <5%（vs 实验/参考）；密度相对波动 <2%（vs WCSPH 基线 <10%）；时间步长 >=1.5x 同精度 WCSPH；守恒量漂移 <1e-10；新增单测 >=3

gap_proposals.title: GPU 邻居搜索/粒子排序后端（现 CPU 邻居表）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 10^6 粒子 3D 溃坝：邻居搜索耗时 <=0.3x 现有 CPU 实现；与 CPU 邻居表交集率 100%（机器检查）；力计算结果与 CPU 基线差 <1e-10；回归全绿

gap_proposals.title: 多相/相变 SPH（气液界面、沸腾/蒸发）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 2D 气泡生长（Young-Laplace 解析压差）：界面压差误差 <3%；液滴振荡周期 vs 解析误差 <5%；质量守恒漂移 <1e-8；新增单测 >=2

gap_proposals.title: 边界处理统一（固壁/移动壁/粒子边界）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 静止壁面法向速度反弹后穿透深度 <0.1h；移动壁面（活塞）动量传递误差 <5%（vs 解析）；无负密度；新增单测 >=3

gap_proposals.title: SPH 收敛性/验证套件（h-收敛阶 + 机器精度守恒）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 2D 涡旋平流 p=1..3（若引入高阶核）：L2 误差 h-收敛阶 >= 核阶-0.15；Young-Laplace 静压误差 <3%；质量/动量漂移 <1e-12；报告收敛表入库

gap_proposals.title: SPH-DEM 颗粒-流体耦合（岩土/泥沙方向）
gap_proposals.acceptance: 落球入水（解析终端速度）：终端速度误差 <5%；颗粒-流体动量交换守恒（漂移 <1e-10）；新增单测 >=2

limitations: unauthenticated GitHub API: stars/pushed_at are point-in-time snapshots (probed_at above), not live
tier/role/focus are curated intent; all numeric fields are API-verbatim
search-based discovery may miss private/renamed repos; wave-2 will re-verify pointers per LBM protocol
census repos that 404'd at probe time are listed in coverage.dropped_no_evidence and excluded from repos[]
